scheduleData.additionalNotes:
DOUBLE THE SHOWS. DOUBLE THE FUN. DOUBLE THE CHANCES TO WIN!
Why settle for one show when you can compete at two fantastic events in one weekend?
Join the German Shepherd Dog Club of Scotland and Clyde Valley GSD club for a celebration of the German Shepherd Dog featuring:
⭐ Two quality shows
⭐ Two judging opportunities
⭐ Fantastic competition
⭐ Friendly Scottish hospitality
⭐ A weekend dedicated to our wonderful breed
Make a weekend of it. Meet old friends, make new ones, and give your dogs the opportunity they deserve.
Enter both shows and be part of one of the highlights of the Scottish show calendar!

Gazebos allowed but must be 2 metres away from the ring.
customStatements: PLEASE NOTE: OUTSIDE ATTRACTION — RKC REGULATION F(1) 16h WILL BE STRICTLY ENFORCED
NO WET WEATHER ACCOMMODATION IS PROVIDED
THIS IS AN UNBENCHED SHOW — EXHIBITORS ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR ENSURING THEIR DOGS ARE AVAILABLE FOR JUDGING
NO PHOTOGRAPHY, FILMING OR OTHER FORM OF RECORDING IS PERMITTED AT THE VENUE OR IN JUDGING RINGS WITHOUT EXPRESS WRITTEN PERMISSION OF THE ORGANISERS
ENTRY FEES CANNOT BE REFUNDED ONCE AN ENTRY HAS BEEN ACCEPTED

scheduleData.bestVeteranInShowEligibility: Best Veteran in Show from classes 10 & 20

classDefinitions.name: JHA Handling (17-24)
classDefinitions.description: For handlers of seventeen and not exceeding twenty-four years of age on the day of the Show. Judged on handling skill, not the dog.

classDefinitions.name: JHA Handling (6-11)
classDefinitions.description: Junior Handling Association class for handlers of six and not exceeding eleven years. JHA membership required.

classDefinitions.name: JHA Handling (12-16)
classDefinitions.description: Junior Handling Association class for handlers of twelve and not exceeding sixteen years. JHA membership required.

classDefinitions.name: Open
classDefinitions.description: For all dogs of the breeds for which the class is provided and eligible for entry at the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Veteran
classDefinitions.description: For dogs of not less than seven years of age on the first day of the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Minor Puppy
classDefinitions.description: For dogs of six and not exceeding nine calendar months of age on the first day of the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Special Long Coat Junior
classDefinitions.description: For Long Coat dogs of six and not exceeding eighteen calendar months of age on the first day of the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Puppy
classDefinitions.description: For dogs of six and not exceeding twelve calendar months of age on the first day of the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Post Graduate
classDefinitions.description: For dogs which have not won a Challenge Certificate/CACIB/CAC/Green Star or five or more First Prizes at Championship Shows in Post Graduate, Minor Limit, Mid Limit, Limit and Open classes, whether restricted or not, where Challenge Certificates were offered for the breed.

classDefinitions.name: Junior
classDefinitions.description: For dogs of six and not exceeding eighteen calendar months of age on the first day of the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Yearling
classDefinitions.description: For dogs of twelve and not exceeding twenty-four calendar months of age on the first day of the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Limit
classDefinitions.description: For dogs which have not become Show Champions under the Royal Kennel Club Regulations or under the rules of any governing body recognised by the Royal Kennel Club, or won seven or more First Prizes in all, at Championship Shows in Limit or Open classes confined to the breed, whether restricted or not, at Shows where Challenge Certificates were offered for the breed.

classDefinitions.name: Special Long Coat Open
classDefinitions.description: For all Long Coat dogs of the breed eligible for entry at the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Special Award Class - Open
classDefinitions.description: For all dogs of the breed for which the class is provided and eligible for entry at the Show. They are not eligible for Challenge Certificates.

classDefinitions.name: Special Award Class - Puppy
classDefinitions.description: For dogs of 6 and not exceeding 12 calendar months of age on the first day of the show. They are not eligible for Challenge Certificates.

classDefinitions.name: Special Award Class - Special Yearling
classDefinitions.description: For dogs of 6 and not exceeding 24 calendar months of age on the first day of the show. They are not eligible for Challenge Certificates.
